entities.summary: Justin Jacob Florek is a former American professional ice hockey player who is currently an unrestricted free agent. He last played with Dresdner Eislöwen in the DEL2. Florek was selected by the Boston Bruins in the 5th round of the 2010 NHL Entry Draft.
